answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces Sybil resistance by requiring random peers to verify each agent. Validators anchor their identity with bonded stake; any fraudulent consensus trigger causes immediate stake slashing. To mask fake identities, an attacker must fake topological cut verifications across the trust graph. This creates a crystal clear superlinear attacker cost scaling with network size until honest verification reaches its zenith.
